import Lean
import Obsmetrologia
open Lean Elab Command

/-!
Spine-lineage census.

The "articulating spine" is the tiered chain of house namespaces the owner's
rule says everything derives from: Mark/Kind (1-mark), Utterance
(2-utterance), Articulating (3-articulating), PredicationCell/Claim/Entity/
Predicate (4-predicating), Charge/Valuation/Meme (5-positing, excluding their
own settling sub-namespaces), and the settling constants themselves
(Charge.Closure, Charge.settle, Charge.joinClosure, Charge.liarClosure,
Valuation.settle, Spine.*) (6-settling). For every house theorem, this census
walks its transitive house-constant closure and records every tier touched.
A theorem touching no tier is standalone mathematics under the namespace, not
derived from articulating — the owner's rule is that everything derives from
articulating.

Output, tab-separated, to stdout only (no files written from Lean):
  `#theorems\t<n>`
  `#touching-spine\t<n>`
  `#deepest\t<tier>\t<count>`                              (one per tier touched, ascending)
  `#module\t<module>\t<theorems>\t<touching>\t<tier=count ...>`   (one per module, most theorems first)
  `<theorem>\t<deepestTier>\t<comma-joined tiers>`          (one per house theorem, name order)
All header lines are informational; the parser recomputes everything from the
theorem rows.
-/

def isHouse (n : Name) : Bool := n.toString.startsWith "Obsmetrologia."

/-- The string-valued dot components of a name, ignoring anonymous and numeric
segments (`Obsmetrologia.Foo.bar` -> `["Obsmetrologia", "Foo", "bar"]`). -/
partial def nameStrComponents : Name → List String
  | .anonymous => []
  | .str p s => nameStrComponents p ++ [s]
  | .num p _ => nameStrComponents p

/-- Lean-elaborator-generated declaration names -- recursors, injectivity/
no-confusion lemmas, equation-compiler helpers, sizeOf plumbing, well-founded
match/proof helpers, etc. -- that must never be counted as house theorems.
True when any dot-separated component begins with `_` (`_proof_1`, `_eq_1`,
`_unfold`, ...), or the last component is one of the fixed auto-generated
names, or begins with `match_`/`proof_`, or is `eq_` followed by one or more
digits (`eq_1`, `eq_2`, ...). A `mk.sizeOf_spec`/`mk.injEq`/`mk.inj`/
`mk.noConfusion` name is already caught by the last-component rule, since
`sizeOf_spec`/`injEq`/`inj`/`noConfusion` is its own last component. See
AGENTS.md defect note (2026-09-21): every census program in this directory
had been counting these as house theorems, inflating every "theorems" total
and (worst, in the certificate-shape census) dominating the top lists with
`Algebra.*.mk.sizeOf_spec` entries. -/
def isAutoGenerated (n : Name) : Bool :=
  let cs := nameStrComponents n
  if cs.any (·.startsWith "_") then true
  else
    match cs.getLast? with
    | none => false
    | some last =>
      [
        "sizeOf_spec", "injEq", "inj", "noConfusion", "noConfusionType",
        "casesOn", "recOn", "rec", "brecOn", "binductionOn",
        "below", "ibelow", "toCtorIdx", "ofNat_toCtorIdx", "ctorIdx", "ctorElim"
      ].contains last
      || last.startsWith "match_"
      || last.startsWith "proof_"
      || (last.startsWith "eq_" && last.length > 3 && (last.drop 3).all Char.isDigit)

/-- Tier of a constant, if it is a spine constant. -/
def tierOf (n : Name) : Option String :=
  let s := n.toString
  if s == "Obsmetrologia.Mark" || s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Mark." || s == "Obsmetrologia.Kind" || s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Kind." then some "1-mark"
  else if s == "Obsmetrologia.Utterance" || s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Utterance." then some "2-utterance"
  else if s == "Obsmetrologia.Articulating" || s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Articulating." then some "3-articulating"
  else if s == "Obsmetrologia.PredicationCell" || s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.PredicationCell." || s == "Obsmetrologia.Claim" || s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Claim." || s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Predicating." || s == "Obsmetrologia.Entity" || s == "Obsmetrologia.Predicate" then some "4-predicating"
  else if s == "Obsmetrologia.Charge" || (s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Charge." && !(s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Charge.Closure") && !(s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Charge.settle") && !(s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Charge.joinClosure") && !(s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Charge.liarClosure")) || s == "Obsmetrologia.Valuation" || (s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Valuation." && !(s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Valuation.settle")) || s == "Obsmetrologia.Meme" || s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Meme." then some "5-positing"
  else if s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Charge.Closure" || s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Charge.settle" || s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Charge.joinClosure" || s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Charge.liarClosure" || s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Valuation.settle" || s.startsWith "Obsmetrologia.Spine." then some "6-settling"
  else none

/-- The distinct tiers touched anywhere in `n`'s transitive house-constant
closure (including `n` itself), memoized. -/
partial def tiersOf (env : Environment) (cache : IO.Ref (Std.HashMap Name (Array String))) (n : Name) : IO (Array String) := do
  if let some s := (← cache.get).get? n then return s
  cache.modify (·.insert n #[])  -- cycle guard
  let some ci := env.find? n | return #[]
  let mut acc : Array String := #[]
  if let some t := tierOf n then acc := acc.push t
  for u in ci.getUsedConstantsAsSet.toList do
    if isHouse u then
      for t in (← tiersOf env cache u) do
        if !acc.contains t then acc := acc.push t
  cache.modify (·.insert n acc)
  return acc

def moduleOf (n : Name) : String :=
  match n.toString.splitOn "." with
  | _ :: m :: _ => m
  | _ => n.toString

#eval show CommandElabM Unit from do
  let env ← getEnv
  let cache ← IO.mkRef ({} : Std.HashMap Name (Array String))
  -- per module: (theorems, touching, deepest-tier histogram)
  let mut perMod : Std.HashMap String (Nat × Nat × Std.HashMap String Nat) := {}
  let mut rows : Array String := #[]
  let mut total := 0
  let mut touching := 0
  let mut deepestHist : Std.HashMap String Nat := {}
  let mut excluded := 0
  for (n, ci) in env.constants.toList do
    if isHouse n && !n.isInternal then
      if let .thmInfo _ := ci then
        if isAutoGenerated n then
          excluded := excluded + 1
        else
          total := total + 1
          let ts ← tiersOf env cache n
          let m := moduleOf n
          let (t, c, h) := perMod.getD m (0, 0, {})
          let deepest := (ts.qsort (· > ·)).getD 0 "0-none"
          let h := h.insert deepest ((h.getD deepest 0) + 1)
          perMod := perMod.insert m (t + 1, c + (if ts.isEmpty then 0 else 1), h)
          if !ts.isEmpty then touching := touching + 1
          deepestHist := deepestHist.insert deepest ((deepestHist.getD deepest 0) + 1)
          rows := rows.push s!"{n}\t{deepest}\t{String.intercalate "," (ts.qsort (· < ·)).toList}"
  IO.println s!"#excluded-auto-generated\t{excluded}"
  IO.println s!"#theorems\t{total}"
  IO.println s!"#touching-spine\t{touching}"
  for (k, c) in (deepestHist.toArray.qsort (fun a b => a.1 < b.1)) do IO.println s!"#deepest\t{k}\t{c}"
  for (m, (t, c, h)) in (perMod.toArray.qsort (fun a b => a.2.1 > b.2.1)) do
    let hs := String.intercalate " " ((h.toArray.qsort (fun a b => a.1 < b.1)).map (fun (k, v) => s!"{k}={v}")).toList
    IO.println s!"#module\t{m}\t{t}\t{c}\t{hs}"
  for r in rows.qsort (· < ·) do IO.println r
